Grace — quick summary after legal review and an ops check:

1) Controller vs Processor mapping
- Our default position: Redwood is a Processor for customer data. The clinical ingestion flow they highlight includes fields Zenodyn controls (subject IDs, labels), so Controller status for Zenodyn is reasonable. Where Zenodyn marked Redwood as Controller (section 3.2 in their redline), we should propose language clarifying that Redwood acts as Processor for hosted & dedicated inference, except where Redwood performs analytics at the explicit direction of Zenodyn (we can enumerate examples).
- Proposed response (short): "Redwood will process customer-provided clinical data as a Processor under the DPA. We acknowledge scenarios where Zenodyn remains the Controller and will document Controller instructions in the onboarding intake."

2) SCCs vs Addendum replacement
- We can accept the EU SCCs (2021 modules) but can't sign a unilateral addendum that rewrites transfer responsibilities without mapping back to SCC modules. Suggest: accept SCCs and include a short transfer addendum clause that references the SCCs and documents the residual risk allocation they propose. This avoids conflicting text.

3) KMS/HSM separation for Dedicated
- Short ops note from infra: Dedicated supports customer-managed keys via KMS integration for on-prem/Dedicated VPC. HSM-level separation (customer-owned HSM) is more involved and would be scoped as an engineering project — feasible but may push deployment 6–8 weeks and incur an onboarding engineering fee.

Action items:
- Grace: do you want Ben to send the short counterproposal email with the two proposed paragraphs (controller/processor + SCC mapping)?
- Karthik: please add a brief bullet we can include on engineering lead time and cost for HSM separation.

I'll leave the wording to Grace/legal for the external reply.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Contracts Counsel | Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced: none (we reviewed Zenodyn PDF offline)

From: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
To: laura.chen@zenodyn.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 15:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Order form + data terms — redlines attached

Laura — thanks for the redlines and context. Below are our narrow counterpoints so we can keep momentum toward your year-end target. Please review and let us know if any of these are deal blockers: 

1) Controller / Processor
- Redwood position (short): Redwood will act as Processor for customer-provided clinical and product data when processing is performed to provide the inference service. We recognize Zenodyn remains Controller for personal data you submit. Where Redwood performs analysis only at Zenodyn's specific instruction that materially changes what data is processed, we will reflect those instructions in the onboarding intake and documented Controller instructions.
- Rationale: preserves standard roles and keeps the DPA aligned with SCCs.

2) SCCs and transfer addendum
- Redwood is agreeable to executing the EU SCCs (modules 1–2–3 as applicable). We cannot accept a standalone addendum that substitutes SCC obligations; instead we propose inserting the short transfer-addendum language you supplied as an exhibit that maps to the SCC module clauses. This approach:
  - Keeps obligations traceable to SCC modules;
  - Captures the residual allocation (your redline) as an exhibit that both sides initial.

3) KMS / HSM for Dedicated deployment
- For the Dedicated configuration in your Order Form v3: we support customer-managed KMS (Cloud KMS integrations) as standard.
- Customer-owned HSM is feasible but will be treated as an onboarding engineering project: estimated lead time 6–8 weeks and a one-time engineering onboarding fee (TBD). If HSM is mandatory for you, we can include a scope note and cost placeholder in the Order Form and convert to a confirmed SOW after signature.

Next steps suggested:
- If Zenodyn accepts the approach above, Ben will prepare two short redline edits: (a) paragraph that clarifies Controller/Processor, (b) clause that references SCCs and attaches their transfer-addendum as an exhibit.
- Karthik to share the HSM lead-time & cost placeholder by Friday EOD so we can add a note to the Order Form.

Please let us know quickly if any of the three items above are blockers to signature timeline. Happy to jump on a 20-min call with Marcus/Laura if that helps resolve the SCC mapping.

Best,
